item.text:
**Verdict**
Tinubu’s 2024 record is a qualified yes on translation into concrete governance. The program was not just rhetorical: it showed up in budget priorities, technocratic coordination structures, welfare delivery rules, new institutions, appointments, and some enforcement moves. The weak point is consistency: timelines were often implicit rather than published, several delivery channels stayed opaque or patronage-prone, and enforcement was sometimes coercive rather than accountability-building.

**Positive evidence**
- **President Tinubu signs 2024 of Renewed Hope, directs MDAs to provide monthly performance reports** | State House | January 1, 2024 | [link](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-signs-2024-of-renewed-hope-directs-mdas-to-provide-monthly-performance-reports/) | The budget was translated into named priorities: defense/internal security, job creation, macro stability, investment, human capital, poverty reduction, and social security, plus monthly performance reporting. This is one of the clearest concrete program-to-budget links. | QIDs: 8B.2; 8B.1
- **Nigeria IMF executive board concludes 2024 Article IV consultation** | IMF | February 9, 2024 | [link](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/02/09/pr2443-nigeria-imf-exec-board-concludes-pfa) | IMF described a coherent stabilization package: subsidy removal, FX unification, a fiscal/tax reform committee, and shock-absorbing palliatives. That shows a program turned into an implementable policy package. | QIDs: 8B.2; 8B.1
- **President Tinubu establishes comprehensive economic coordination and planning system for Nigeria** | State House | March 27, 2024 | [link](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-comprehensive-economic-coordination-and-planning-system-for-nigeria/) | Tinubu created PECC/EET structures centered on the finance minister and CBN governor, with economists and private-sector figures, and ordered rapid implementation. This is strong evidence of institutionalized execution rather than slogan-only reform. | QIDs: 8B.2; 8B.1
- **In detail: The Student Loan (Access to Higher Education) Act, 2024** | State House | April 4, 2024 | [link](https://statehouse.gov.ng/in-detail-the-student-loan-access-to-higher-education-act-2024/) | The reform was converted into a standing law and delivery structure, broadening access to higher education and skills training. This is a concrete institutional mechanism, not a one-off announcement. | QIDs: 8B.2; 8B.1
- **President Tinubu appoints management team of the Nigerian Education Loan Fund** | State House | April 5, 2024 | [link](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-appoints-management-team-of-the-nigerian-education-loan-fund/) | He staffed NELFUND with a named management team described as qualified professionals. That is a direct appointments-to-program link. | QIDs: 8B.2
- **President Tinubu directs expeditious processing of welfare benefits, demands monthly KPI reports** | State House | February 22, 2024 | [link](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-expeditious-processing-of-welfare-benefits-demands-monthly-kpi-reports/) | Tinubu turned welfare rhetoric into administrative process rules: faster delivery, no delays, and monthly KPI reporting. This is one of the best examples of timelines and monitoring. | QIDs: 8B.2; 8B.1
- **Nigeria restarts cash transfers to cushion hardship caused by reforms** | Reuters via MarketScreener | February 26, 2024 | [link](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Nigeria-restarts-cash-transfers-to-cushion-hardship-caused-by-reforms-46031196/) | The government resumed direct cash transfers to 12 million vulnerable households, showing broad social protection as an implemented compensatory mechanism. | QIDs: 8B.2
- **President Tinubu directs reorganisation of the Bureau of Public Procurement** | State House | June 15, 2024 | [link](https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/) | Procurement reform is a concrete institutional move aimed at transparency, value for money, and less rent-seeking. This is the clearest anti-opaque-spending mechanism in the record. | QIDs: 8B.2; 7B.10
- **My Resolve to Enhance Nigeria’s Security Unwavering** | State House | April 22, 2024 | [link](https://statehouse.gov.ng/my-resolve-to-enhance-nigerias-security-unwavering-president-tinubu/) | Tinubu backed state policing as a way to improve accountability and safeguard civil liberties. This is concrete institutional design, even if still mostly at the policy level. | QIDs: 8B.2; 8B.1
- **Tinubu orders probe of security agents involved in arrest, detention of minors** | TheCable | November 4, 2024 | [link](https://www.thecable.ng/tinubu-orders-probe-of-security-agents-involved-in-arrest-detention-of-minors/) | After the protest crackdown, he ordered an investigation, review process, and possible discipline for officers. This is the strongest late-year enforcement/accountability step. | QIDs: 8B.2; 7B.10
- **U.S.-Nigeria reach agreement to harness artificial intelligence, facilitate data flows and empower digital upskilling** | Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy | July 27, 2024 | [link](https://fmcide.gov.ng/u-s-nigeria-reach-agreement-to-harness-artificial-intelligence-facilitate-data-flows-and-empower-digital-upskilling-issue-joint-statement/) | The administration publicly committed to open, interoperable, secure internet language plus AI cooperation and workforce upskilling. That is concrete, externally legible policy direction. | QIDs: 8B.2

**Negative / limiting evidence**
- **Tinubu under fire for appointing son-in-law head of housing agency** | BusinessDay | February 21, 2024 | [link](https://businessday.ng/news/article/tinubu-under-fire-for-appointing-son-in-law-head-of-housing-agency/) | The son-in-law appointment to the Federal Housing Authority is the clearest patronage signal in the 2024 record. It undercuts a clean technocratic translation of the program. | QIDs: 8B.2; 7B.10
- **Reps blame agric ministry for delay in sharing Tinubu’s palliative** | The Guardian Nigeria | January 9, 2024 | [link](https://guardian.ng/news/reps-blame-agric-ministry-for-delay-in-sharing-tinubus-palliative/) | Relief was routed through lawmakers for constituent distribution, creating a discretionary and politically exposed channel. That is a weak, opaque implementation mechanism. | QIDs: 8B.2; 7B.10
- **Tinubu gives ministers 1,200 bags of rice each as palliatives for distribution** | The Guardian Nigeria | September 17, 2024 | [link](https://guardian.ng/news/tinubu-govt-prioritises-inclusive-palliative-distribution-maryam-shettima/) | Even the defense of the palliative regime still relied on politically mediated distribution through appointees rather than an arms-length system. | QIDs: 8B.2; 7B.10
- **Nigeria has detained journalist who reported on corruption in widening crackdown** | Reuters via GPB | May 9, 2024 | [link](https://www.gpb.org/news/2024/05/09/nigeria-has-detained-journalist-who-reported-on-corruption-in-widening-crackdown) | Investigative journalism was punished under cybercrime law, which weakens the feedback loop needed for program correction and clean implementation. | QIDs: 8B.2; 7B.10
- **Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting** | CPJ | October 3, 2024 | [link](https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/) | Continued cybercrime charges against journalists show that scrutiny of spending and appointments still triggered retaliation late in 2024. | QIDs: 8B.2; 7B.10
- **Nigeria charges protesters with treason, inciting military** | Reuters via ThePrint | September 2, 2024 | [link](https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/) | The state escalated dissent into treason/mutiny allegations, which looks like coercive regime protection more than neutral program enforcement. | QIDs: 8B.2; 7B.10
- **Nigeria: Police used excessive force to violently quash #EndBadGovernance protests** | Amnesty International | November 28, 2024 | [link](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/) | The crackdown produced killings, mass detentions, and torture allegations. That shows enforcement capacity, but not the kind of rights-constrained enforcement the program rhetoric implied. | QIDs: 8B.2; 7B.10
- **FG spent N63.6bn on military equipment in seven months - report** | Punch | August 17, 2024 | [link](https://punchng.com/fg-spent-n63-6bn-on-military-equipment-in-seven-months-report/) | Large, weakly disclosed security spending points to a real budgeted priority, but it also raises opacity and diversion concerns. | QIDs: 8B.2
- **Nigeria considers tough penalties for subversive acts under proposed law** | Reuters via Investing.com | August 14, 2024 | [link](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/nigeria-considers-tough-penalties-for-subversive-acts-under-proposed-law-3571782) | The proposed Counter Subversion Bill suggests the administration was also translating its program into a narrower, punitive control posture. | QIDs: 8B.2; 7B.10
- **Nigeria restarts cash transfers to cushion hardship caused by reforms** | Reuters via MarketScreener | February 26, 2024 | [link](https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Nigeria-restarts-cash-transfers-to-cushion-hardship-caused-by-reforms-46031196/) | This is positive as social protection, but it also shows the core reform package required compensatory relief because the adjustment was severe. | QIDs: 8B.2

**Synthesis**
Tinubu did translate the 2024 program into visible machinery: budgets, committees, laws, agencies, appointments, procurement reform, welfare reporting, and some enforcement. The strongest implementation evidence is in macro coordination and social-policy plumbing. The main weaknesses are opacity, patronage contamination in some appointments and distribution channels, and a coercive security response that does not fit a clean “institution-building” reading.

**Search gap**
I did not find a single public 2024 implementation masterplan with clear milestones, deadlines, and published scorecards. Most evidence comes from speeches, press releases, and isolated institutional moves, so confidence on actual execution quality remains lower than confidence on the existence of a program and supporting apparatus.
